display.purpose: Hero headline only; Playfair 900, balanced wrap, max-width 17ch, centered.

headline.purpose: Section h2s; ends with an italic-600 flourish in Foil Catching Light.

flourish.purpose: Playfair italic 600 in gold: door promises, signature (1.55rem), thank-you line (1.9rem); grey italic for quiet asides.

label.purpose: Inter 600 uppercase 0.72-0.8rem, 0.16-0.22em tracking. Content lines, captions, field labels, buttons, nav. Never a kicker above a heading.

shadows.name: resting-mat
shadows.purpose: Under the portrait photo mat; strip frames use 0 20px 44px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.85).

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Foil button hover, paired with translateY(-2px).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The single house ease for every transition and animation.

motion.name: stamp
motion.purpose: Hero plate double border draws itself (pathLength 100); reduced-motion gated.

motion.name: hero-rise
motion.purpose: Staggered hero entrance: seal, headline, fleuron+sub, CTAs, conference line.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: IntersectionObserver scroll reveals (rootMargin -8% bottom, threshold .1); visible by default without JS or with reduced motion.

motion.name: micro
motion.purpose: Color/border shifts .3s; button lift .35s; engraved-link underline draw .5s from left.

components.name: Foil Button
components.description: The one gold-stamped primary action per view region (Book a Call / Send It).
components.css: .ds-btn-foil { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: .8rem; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; padding: 1.05rem 2.1rem; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--gold-2, #e6c877), var(--gold, #c9a24b)); color: #14100a; border: 1px solid var(--gold-2, #e6c877); transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-foil:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 14px 28px -14px rgba(0,0,0,.75); } .ds-btn-foil:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #c9a24b); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Hairline Button
components.description: The blind-emboss secondary action beside the foil button.
components.css: .ds-btn-line { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: .8rem; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; padding: 1.05rem 2.1rem; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; color: var(--gold-2, #e6c877); border: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(201,162,75,.32)); transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background-color .35s, border-color .35s, color .35s; } .ds-btn-line:hover { border-color: var(--gold-2, #e6c877); background: rgba(201,162,75,.07); color: var(--ink, #f4f1ea); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-line:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #c9a24b); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Engraved Link
components.description: Tertiary small-caps link on a hairline; a gold line draws over it on hover.
components.css: .ds-link-engraved { position: relative; display: inline-block; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: .78rem; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold-2, #e6c877); padding-bottom: .45rem; transition: color .3s; } .ds-link-engraved::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; height: 1px; width: 100%; background: var(--rule, rgba(201,162,75,.32)); } .ds-link-engraved::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; height: 1px; width: 100%; background: var(--gold-2, #e6c877); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); z-index: 1; } .ds-link-engraved:hover { color: var(--ink, #f4f1ea); } .ds-link-engraved:hover::before { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-link-engraved:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #c9a24b); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Reply-Card Field
components.description: Underline-only form field with a small-caps gold label; underline turns foil on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { max-width: 22rem; } .ds-field-label { display: block; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: .72rem; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold, #c9a24b); margin-bottom: .45rem; } .ds-req { color: var(--gold-2, #e6c877); } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(244,241,234,.22); color: var(--ink, #f4f1ea); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; padding: .65rem .1rem; border-radius: 0; transition: border-color .3s; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: rgba(167,169,180,.75); } .ds-field-input:focus { border-bottom-color: var(--gold, #c9a24b); outline: none; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #c9a24b); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Suite Card

components.css: .ds-suite { position: relative; background: var(--stock, #0d0f15); border: 1px solid var(--rule-dim, rgba(201,162,75,.14)); padding: 3rem; } .ds-suite::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(201,162,75,.08); pointer-events: none; } .ds-suite-h2 { font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 2.1rem; line-height: 1.12; letter-spacing: -.01em; color: var(--ink, #f4f1ea); margin: 0; } .ds-suite-h2 em { font-style: italic; font-weight: 600; color: var(--gold-2, #e6c877); } .ds-suite-lede { margin: 1.2rem 0 0; color: var(--soft, #a7a9b4); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1.7; max-width: 64ch; } .ds-head-rule { width: 74px; height: 1px; background: var(--gold, #c9a24b); margin-top: 1.8rem; opacity: .75; }

components.name: Matted Photograph
components.description: Photo matted on second-sheet stock with a foil inner border, black resting shadow, small-caps caption.
components.css: .ds-mat-fig { margin: 0; max-width: 300px; } .ds-mat { background: var(--stock-2, #12151d); border: 1px solid var(--rule-dim, rgba(201,162,75,.14)); padding: .8rem; box-shadow: 0 20px 44px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.85); } .ds-mat-photo { border: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(201,162,75,.32)); height: 200px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #0b1a33, #08090c); } .ds-mat-caption { margin-top: .9rem; text-align: center; color: var(--soft, #a7a9b4); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: .76rem; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.html:

components.css: .ds-ledger { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; max-width: 32ch; } .ds-ledger li { padding: .78rem 0; color: var(--soft, #a7a9b4); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: .95rem; line-height: 1.55; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(244,241,234,.07); } .ds-ledger li:first-child { border-top: 1px solid rgba(244,241,234,.07); } .ds-ledger strong { color: var(--ink, #f4f1ea); font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
Every surface in this world is a piece of a formal engraved invitation suite: card-stock panels laid on a near-black table, navy tissue showing through underneath, and champagne foil die-stamped into the stock as hairlines, double rules, a monogram seal, and one gold button per view. The page refuses the dark-SaaS template — no glowing hero, no icon-card grid, no gradient text. Its luxury is stationer's luxury: restraint, symmetry, hairline precision, and real photographs matted like keepsakes. A faint fixed film grain gives the black its card-stock tooth.

Density is generous and ceremonial. Sections arrive as discrete cards separated by 7rem of bare table, each carrying its own hairline border and a second inset rule 10px inside — the double-plate signature. Structure inside a card is drawn, never boxed: columns are divided by vertical hairlines, list rows by ledger rules, and the form is a reply card whose fields are single underlines. Motion is engraver's motion: rules draw themselves, content rises gently on one shared ease, and everything degrades to fully-visible stillness under reduced motion or without JS.
keyCharacteristics: Two-foil champagne accent (#c9a24b standing, #e6c877 catching light) spent almost entirely on 1px rules, small caps, italic flourishes, and a single stamped button
Playfair Display 700-900 ceremonial voice with italic-600 flourishes; Inter 400-700 as the functional hand
Hairline-drawn structure (dividers, ledgers, double rules) instead of filled boxes or cards-with-icons
Authored SVG ornaments only: JS monogram seal, diamond fleuron divider, hairline hamburger
Real photographs matted on second-sheet stock; full-bleed imagery always scrimmed back to near-black and navy
One easing for everything: cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1); reveals opt in via JS and honor prefers-reduced-motion

rules.name: The Foil Budget Rule
rules.body: Champagne foil is spent on hairlines, small caps, italic flourishes, ornament strokes, and at most one gold-filled button per view. It is never a background wash, never text-fill gradient, never a glow.

rules.name: The Two Foils Rule
rules.body: #c9a24b is standing foil (labels, rules, strokes); #e6c877 is foil catching light (emphasis, links, monogram letters, hovers). Hover resolves gold toward ink (#f4f1ea), not toward brighter gold.

rules.name: The Tissue Rule
rules.body: Navy #0b1a33 appears only inside gradients and scrims as an undertone — never as a flat panel color, border, or text color.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: The small-caps voice (Inter 600, 0.78rem, 0.22em, uppercase, Champagne Foil) is a voice for lines of content — the hero's engraved conference line, the speaking meta line, captions, field labels — separated by middot separators in Foil Rule when listed. It never sits above a heading as a kicker or eyebrow. Headings introduce themselves.

rules.name: The Italic Flourish Rule
rules.body: Emphasis inside any Playfair heading is italic 600 in Foil Catching Light — never bolder weight, never underline, never a second color family.

rules.name: The Rotating Hairline Rule
rules.body: When a hairline-divided grid stacks, its vertical dividers become horizontal ones (border-left to border-top). Divisions are never dropped and never replaced with boxes or gaps.

rules.name: The Black Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is neutral black at low spread, cast downward. No colored glows, no gold halos, no ambient accent shadows — foil shines by contrast, not by bloom.

dos: Do draw structure with hairlines — Foil Rule Dim for quiet structure, Foil Rule for emphasis, Ink Hairline for ledger rows — and rotate dividers (left-border to top-border) when grids stack.
Do end section headlines with an italic Playfair flourish in Foil Catching Light, and reserve strong-in-grey (ink, 600) as the only in-paragraph emphasis.
Do spend gold on at most one foil button per view region, pairing it with a hairline button or engraved link for the quieter path.
Do mat every photograph (Second Sheet mat + Foil Rule inner border + black resting shadow + small-caps caption) or scrim it to near-black/navy when full-bleed.
Do keep motion on the single house ease, opt-in via JS (html.js), gated by prefers-reduced-motion, and fully visible without either.
Do mark unresolved facts as labeled placeholder slots (italic grey on dashed foil underline) with REPLACE: comments — honest slots, never invented content.
donts: Don't use gradient text. The system's only gradient is the foil button surface; type is always a solid ink or foil.
Don't build icon-card grids. There are no icons beyond the authored seal, fleuron, hamburger, and select-chevron SVGs; capability lists are ledger-ruled text.
Don't put a kicker or small-caps eyebrow above any heading. The small-caps voice is content (meta lines, captions, labels), never a heading's warm-up.
Don't cast colored or glowing shadows. Shadows are soft black and downward; foil never blooms.
Don't round corners past the 2px stamp radius, and never on cards, mats, photos, or fields.
Don't introduce new hues. The world is three dark stocks, two inks, two foils, and a navy that lives only inside gradients.
